acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:6714d9a8-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As our founding Channel Manager for the French market, you’ll manage Vanta channel partnerships across the region, driving our partners to sell and deploy Vanta more broadly. This role sits within Vanta’s Partnerships team, where you will have a direct role in bringing Vanta’s vision of securing every technology company through channel partners. You will help us ensure that our partners always receive quality guidance and enablement as they go-to-market with Vanta. This role will be based from either our Dublin or London office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. What you’ll do as a Channel Manager for the French market at Vanta: - Drive net new pipeline and ARR for the French market via a book of channel partners (service and sales oriented) - Enable and build relationships with existing Vanta partners - Direct a one-to-many approach to developing business within the region - Build one-to-one relationships with key partners across France - Manage your pipeline effectively, working alongside Account Executives in the business to close deals How to be successful in this role: - 4+ years of channel partner experience working within software/SaaS - Fluency in written and spoken English and French required - Must be able to work 3 days per week in our Dublin or London offices with 2 days at home - Excellent cross-functional team player that can execute and can contribute to strategy - Highly driven self-starter that thrives in a dynamic environment - Customer focused approach - Experience in operations, with an ability to help create and organize business processes and systems - Understanding and experience with IT Service Providers and the IT Channel. - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact What you can expect as a Vanta’n: - Industry-competitive salary and equity - 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents - Health & wellness stipend - Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend - Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office - Pension matching - 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time - 8 company-paid holidays - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney #LI-hybrid At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. aios-aios:ashbyhq:af3cb2a1-f449-4b6b-894.description: ABOUT AIOS AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor. We’re at $350M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor. We’re faithfully serving >150k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable. Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses: 1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history. 2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders. Our master plan: - Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market. - Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR. - Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider. - Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. - Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company. We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS https://app.notion.com/p/Working-at-AIOS-5b5c0a584af44de78ac7fb9b2cf8d993?pvs=21 BEING AN AFFILIATE LEAD AT AIOS We are building a world-class team. As Affiliate Lead at AIOS, your fundamental role is to turn affiliates into a cleanly attributable, scalable, and profitable customer acquisition channel, starting with Bolt Pharmacy (UK). This is not a “link in bio” creator affiliate program role. This is not a coordination-only, admin role. You will own the program end to end, beginning with recruiting high quality affiliates that you forge lasting partnerships with. You’ll be in the weeds iterating offers, systems, and comms to elevate overall affiliate performance. You’ll: - Grow affiliate-attributed revenue - Ensure attribution is tidy - Increase the output of our strongest existing partners, and cut underperformers - Build offers, promotions, and incentives that affiliates can win with (while keeping us profitable) - Make the program operationally reliable, measurable, and easy to scale - Protect our brands by maintaining a high bar for content compliance, claims, and attribution Great performance means affiliates become a predictable and increasingly important growth channel. Attribution is clean and cannibalization is minimalized. If you really nail the role, you’ll be a leading candidate for our future Head of Affiliate hire and other Senior Growth Hires. This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work async in the timezone of your choice — as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time for calls as needed. You’ll report directly to Marie Boes https://www.linkedin.com/in/marie-boes-seo/ (AI Growth Lead). You’ll also work most closely with: - Dave Lane https://www.linkedin.com/in/davidanthonylane/?skipRedirect=true (Head of Performance) - Michael McCann https://www.linkedin.com/in/michael-mccann-33b79642/ (Head of CRO) - Richie Cartwright https://www.linkedin.com/in/richard-cartwright/ (CEO + Interim Head of Growth) KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Revenue: You’ll own affiliate-attributed revenue. You’ll identify the biggest growth opportunities, set the plan, and deliver. Attribution is clean, always. - Sourcing: You’ll build a consistent pipeline of high-quality affiliates across publishers, comparison sites, content partners, creators, communities, and other relevant channels. - Reporting: You’ll build a clear view of affiliate performance across revenue, attribution, conversion, CAC, retention, refunds, activ

s2ginvestments-ana-corp:lever:c6c10e1e-6.description: Burro is the leading robotics company in the world by number of robots working outdoors in the field with real customers. Our mission is to free people from tedious work and solve the critical labor shortages faced by farmers and others that work outdoors. To accomplish our mission, we need a world-class, diverse team where everyone feels comfortable sharing their ideas. With this in mind, we strive to create a work environment where every employee can be themselves and express their perspective – this enables us to deliver the most creative and innovative solutions to problems our customers face. Headquartered in Philadelphia with an office in central California, and backed by top Agtech and autonomy investors, including S2G, Catalyst, Translink, Cibus, FPrime, Toyota Ventures, FFVC, Xplorer, and Radicle, Burro was created to solve the labor shortages facing farmers using robotics. Burros can be described as Disney's Wall-E for agriculture and work outdoors, in a 1.0 format. They function, today, as computer vision based autonomous ground vehicles for carrying, towing, and scouting, and are designed to lay the base for the fully autonomous future of work outdoors. We have a growing triple digit fleet deployed in paid commercial use within vineyards, nurseries, berries, and beyond, and demand for our product is accelerating, so we are growing our team. Reporting to our Chief Revenue Officer, we're looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst to own the systems, data, and processes that power our revenue engine. You'll be the operational backbone of our sales team — keeping HubSpot running well, making sure our pipeline data is trustworthy, and helping leadership make smarter decisions faster. Own and administer HubSpot CRM, including pipeline configuration, workflow automation, custom reporting and dashboards, data hygiene, and integrations with our broader tech stack. Build and maintain reporting on revenue KPIs, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy, and deliver regular updates to the CRO and senior leadership. Give the revenue team a complete, 360-degree view of each customer spanning product usage, engagement signals (support tickets, sales emails, marketing touches, and attribution), and contract data — so reps spend less time digging and more time selling. Partner with GTM leadership to identify and drive process improvements that reduce friction in the sales cycle and improve rep productivity. Work cross-functionally to ensure CRM governance, data integrity, and reporting accuracy across the organization. Bachelor’s degree in liberal arts, business, marketing, or related field Relentless curiosity around how customers use autonomous solutions to reduce the labor intensity of their operations 3-5 years of revenue operations, sales operations, or a closely related field Hands-on HubSpot CRM administration experience building workflows, automations, custom properties, pipeline stages, and dashboards Entrepreneurial mindset with ability to work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders Excellent organizational skills with the ability to handle and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously Willingness to travel up to 20% (primarily customer and field visits) Experience connecting HubSpot to other tools in the revenue stack Familiarity with the agriculture industry Experience in a hands-on startup environment Competitive salary and benefits package (medical/dental/vision) Early-Stage Equity 401K Plan Unlimited PTO Paid parental leave RECRUITERS: We are not accepting agency resumes for this position. Please do not forward or submit resumes through our website or to any of our employees directly. Burro is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies.
